description:
Partner Manager

Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend. We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend. We’re looking for a talented and team-driven Partner Manager to join us on our journey.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Procurify is looking for a well-connected, commercially sharp, and relationship-driven person who is passionate about building revenue through partners.

 

You are a person with a knack for turning long-standing relationships across ERP ecosystems, accounting firms, and advisory practices into qualified pipeline, and you’re motivated by helping our customers achieve the best version of themselves.

 

Everyone at Procurify is a team player. A big part of this role involves building relationships internally and externally and advocating for our customers. We’re seeking entrepreneurial people who are willing to challenge the status quo and contribute to larger strategic objectives.

This role will also play a part in how we continue to evolve as an AI-enhanced platform. You’ll use AI-assisted research to map partner client lists against our ideal customer profile and find mutual accounts, and you’ll help partners understand where agentic procurement fits in the Office of the CFO.

 

What you’ll be working on:

  • Open new partner channels:
    Identify, recruit, and onboard new partners across ERP resellers and implementation partners, accounting and advisory firms, and outsourced accounting providers. Negotiate referral and reseller agreements, and get new partners from signed agreement to first referral quickly.

  • Grow existing partner relationships:
    Own a portfolio of established partners and grow the business we do together. Build joint business plans, run regular business reviews, and build relationships at every level, from partner leadership to the consultants and implementers who influence software decisions day to day.

  • Co-sell across ERP ecosystems:
    Work alongside our AEs and partner sellers across NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and newer cloud ERPs. Map shared accounts, make introductions, and support deals from first conversation through close. Manage deal registration and keep partner pipeline accurate in Salesforce.

  • Enable partners and internal teams:
    Build and deliver partner onboarding, training, and sales resources so partners can position Procurify with confidence and know when to bring us in. Help Sales, BDR, and Customer Success understand how to work with partners on their deals.

  • Drive co-marketing and events:
    Work with Marketing on joint webinars, events, content, and campaigns that generate pipeline. Represent Procurify at industry conferences and partner events across North America.

  • Bring partner insights to Product:
    Share integration and workflow feedback from partners and shared customers with Product, and help shape joint value propositions. Use data and AI-assisted analysis to track partner performance and spot where to focus next.

 

Who we’re looking for

  • 4+ years in partnerships, alliances, channel, or sales roles in the mid-market ERP, accounting, or finance technology space.

  • Established relationships across mid-market ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics), regional and national accounting and advisory firms, and outsourced accounting providers that you can activate in your first 90 days

  • A track record of partner-sourced pipeline and closed revenue, with numbers you can walk us through

  • Experience co-selling with AEs and partner sellers from first referral through close

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to quickly qualify which partners and opportunities are worth pursuing

  • Willing to travel within North America for partner events, conferences, and in-person meetings

  • Bonus: background in procurement, AP, or spend management software, or experience selling into biotech, nonprofit, education, or public sector organizations

  • Demonstrates curiosity and adaptability in leveraging new technologies, including AI, to improve productivity, decision-making, or customer outcomes

  • Maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.

WHY PROCURIFY?

Help us modernize spend management

 

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend, transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

 

Powered by our $50M Series C funding, we are actively expanding our core offering, launching new payment capabilities, and building an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience for our customers. Read the press release here. With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.

 

The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.

 

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.

 

Be empowered to do your best work

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

 

  • Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada

  • Responsible time off: We offer a flexible approach to time off; we trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.

  • Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.

  • Continuous Learning: We host regular educational lunch and learns to help our team grow, share knowledge, and stay curious.

  • Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.

  • On Target Earnings (OTE) Range:
    Canada:     $90,500 – $105,000 CAD

This range is dependent on experience, with a component of these earnings made up of variable pay (70/30 base-to-variable split) and not inclusive of any benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package.

 

LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

 

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.

 

Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.
